site.name: Lü Ganhua Foundation
site.tagline: An independent memorial and knowledge site honoring Dr. Lü Ganhua

banner.noFees: We do not charge fees or request payments of any kind. We also do not provide funding or grants.

home.heroTitle: Advancing Care and Compassion in Memory of Dr. Lü Ganhua
home.heroSubtitle: A non-commercial, independent foundation dedicated to preserving medical wisdom and honoring a life of healing.
home.mission: In remembrance, we honor a life of healing and dignity.

about.title: About the Foundation
about.body: Dedicated to preserving Dr. Lü Ganhua's legacy through education, research archives, and the promotion of compassionate medicine — with full independence and transparency.

life.title: Life & Milestones
life.intro: Tracing the key moments that defined a remarkable career in medicine and service.

legacy.title: Memorial & Legacy
legacy.intro: Selected tributes, photographs, and remembrance submissions honoring Dr. Lü Ganhua's enduring impact.

team.title: Leadership & Governance
team.intro: In accordance with U.S. nonprofit foundation practices, we publicly disclose our officers, board members, and governance structure.
team.disclaimer: This is an initial listing for transparency. Registration and filing details will be published as they become available.

archives.title: Archives & Publications
archives.intro: A curated collection of publications, talks, interviews, and media materials — with proper metadata and citation formats for academic use.

participate.title: Get Involved
participate.intro: Join us in honoring Dr. Lü Ganhua's legacy — through scholarships, medical talent grants, memory submissions, and the oral history project. No fees or payments involved.
participate.scholarshipsDesc: Need and merit-based awards to support outstanding students in medical and related disciplines.
participate.medTalentDesc: Targeted support for clinicians, trainees, and educators advancing patient-centered care.

antiFraud.title: Anti-Fraud Statement
antiFraud.body: We never charge fees and never request any payment. We do not provide funding or grants. Beware of any message claiming otherwise.
antiFraud.contact: If in doubt, contact us via the official domain lyuganhua.org.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: Reach out through our official channels for inquiries, media requests, or to participate in our projects.
